source.title: Simple Online and Realtime Tracking with a Deep Association Metric
source.venue: IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) 2017, pp. 3645-3649

confidence_rationale: DeepSORT is the engineering blueprint for MECH-045's token KEY: it maintains per-object tracks across time and occlusion by DATA ASSOCIATION combining a motion gate (Kalman/Mahalanobis spatiotemporal continuity) with an appearance embedding, assigning persistent track ids with NO category label. This is exactly REE's proposal -- spatiotemporal-continuity data-association over z_world features -- with z_world standing in for the appearance descriptor. It supplies the concrete update rule (predict -> gate -> match -> birth/death) the biological sources leave unspecified, and the identity-switch metric is the natural quantitative readout for the experiment. Confidence 0.7: high mechanistic mapping fidelity, discounted because it is engineering (not evidence the brain does this), relies on a SUPERVISED person-reID appearance metric REE does not have, and assumes a detector REE lacks.
failure_signatures: DeepSORT's appearance metric is a SUPERVISED descriptor pre-trained on a large person-reID dataset; REE has no labelled identity data and must use unsupervised z_world. If z_world is not discriminative enough (the dim=32 ceiling), the appearance term degenerates and association falls back to motion-only -- which is the location-collapse vacuity mode in disguise.

It assumes an external object DETECTOR proposing bounding boxes each frame; REE has no detector, so the 'what counts as a trackable entity this tick' step (figure-ground / candidate proposal) is an unsolved upstream dependency the buffer cannot assume away.

Pure tracking-by-detection has no notion of value, attention-gating, or precision-weighting; it associates everything uniformly. MECH-045's attention-gated, precision-weighted continuity is an ADDITION to the DeepSORT recipe, not part of it.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Multi-object tracking can be done online by tracking-by-detection: a Kalman filter predicts each existing track's next state; detections are associated to tracks by a cost combining a Mahalanobis MOTION gate with a cosine distance in a learned APPEARANCE-embedding space (a deep metric pre-trained on person re-identification); unmatched detections birth new tracks and unmatched tracks age out and die. Adding the appearance metric lets tracks survive long occlusions and sharply reduces identity switches versus motion-only SORT.
mapping.ree_translation: DeepSORT is the computational instantiation of MECH-045's token KEY. Its predict->gate->match->birth/death loop IS the data-association mechanism REE proposes: assign a persistent token id to an entity by combining spatiotemporal continuity (the motion gate) with a feature match (the appearance term), with NO type/category label -- track ids are bare instance pointers. REE substitutes z_world for the appearance descriptor and gets a per-token feature buffer for free (the track's stored embedding). The identity-switch count and track-purity are the natural quantitative metrics for the persistence-vs-ablation experiment, and the appearance-vs-motion ablation in the paper is the methodological template for REE's intact-vs-shuffled-identity arms.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Engineering system, not evidence about brains -- it shows the mechanism is SUFFICIENT for tracking, not that REE or biology implements it. It depends on a supervised reID appearance metric and an external detector, neither of which REE has; the biological plausibility and the unsupervised-z_world substitution are the open risks. The attention-gating and precision-weighting MECH-045 requires are not in DeepSORT.
mapping.source_context: Computer-vision multi-object-tracking method (IEEE ICIP 2017); evaluated on the MOT pedestrian-tracking benchmark; the canonical appearance+motion data-association tracker.

confidence_components.notes: Widely-used, well-validated method (the de-facto baseline for appearance-based MOT). Mapping fidelity high because it is literally the proposed KEY mechanism. Source quality good but it is an applied conference method, not a controlled study of representation; transfer risk from supervised-reID + detector assumptions to REE's unsupervised detectorless setting is the main discount.
